entities.title: Usage log
entities.summary: One JSON line per MCP tool call and per hook decision that blocked or let a raw command through, in usage.jsonl in the state directory.
entities.name: usage.jsonl
entities.meaning: What an agent asked, how the answer was produced and what it cost: the input zazzle-csharp-indexer report summarises to decide what to build next.
dimensions: session: 8-hex id of the MCP session, or Claude Code's session_id for hook records
args: argument names with numbers and booleans as given and strings as 12-hex SHA-256 prefixes; in arrays the first element and flags are kept
path: how the answer was produced (index, scan, fallback:rg, fallback:git-grep, run:<program>, view, hook)
reason: why, when not plainly from the index (index_cold, regex_unsupported, passthrough, git, unchanged_since_last_read, gap_report, blocked:<program>, allowed_raw:<program>)
bytes_out and est_tokens (bytes / 4) of the answer
results, truncated, candidates, files: what the tool reported (candidates and files are -1 when the tool does not count them)
note: report_gap text, cut to 500 characters
error: the tool's error code, or null
entities.access: The user who owns the state directory; nothing is sent anywhere.
entities.retention: When usage.jsonl passes 20 MiB it is renamed to usage.jsonl.1 (replacing the previous one) before the next write; nothing else is deleted.
excludes: Argument text, unless ZAZZLE_INDEXER_LOG_PLAIN=1 (the report_gap note is stored in the note field in plain text either way)
Hook calls that were simply allowed
entities.details: Write failures are ignored, and a state directory that cannot be created disables the hook's logging. A user-facing pointer to the log stays in the README's Usage log section.

entities.title: Notes on standard error
entities.summary: serve says when it falls back to serving in process, and the index says when change tracking is unavailable for a root.
entities.meaning: "zazzle-csharp-indexer: no daemon (<reason>); serving in-process" means the shared daemon could not be reached or used; "zazzle-csharp-indexer: change tracking unavailable for <root> (<message>); relying on periodic reconcile" means the root is refreshed only every five minutes and by query barriers.
entities.access: Whoever reads the process's standard error: the MCP client for serve; for a spawned daemon it goes to /dev/null.
